hook.text: You have reached the end of World 5, and the end of the Arrays + Functions Mastery journey! Now it is time to test yourself with mixed questions.

concept.heading: Checkpoint
concept.body: This lesson does not teach a new topic; it reinforces what you have learned. The questions below test the array concept, traversal, search, finding the largest/smallest, matrices, functions, and scope in a mix.

exercises.question: What does this code write to the screen?
exercises.hint: In an array of 4 elements, index 3 is the LAST element.

exercises.question: What does this code write to the screen?
In a linear search, what does it mean if "position" is still -1 when the loop ends?
options: The target element was not found

feedback.correct: Correct. -1 shows that no match was found.
feedback.incorrect: If the -1 starting value was not updated, the target element is not in the array.

What does this code write to the screen?
What does this code write to the screen?
What happens if an assignment is made inside a function to a variable with the same name as a global variable?
options: The global variable is changed for good
A new local variable is created, and the global does not change
Both are updated at the same time

feedback.correct: Correct. An assignment inside a function creates a new local variable that does not affect the global one.
feedback.incorrect: An assignment inside a function creates a new LOCAL variable, even with the same name; the global is not affected.
